name: ar_aging
title: Receivables aging by customer at 30 June 2026
purpose: Open invoices aged by days past due into five buckets per customer, with invoice counts, the overdue share and the amount over 90 days. The bucket is found with MATCH on the bucket bounds and INDEX on the bucket names instead of a ladder of nested IFs.
limitations: Template of the rule-of-thumb-model plugin: the open items are generated by make_data.py (seed 20261125).
Days past due = the as-of date minus the due date; a negative number means not yet due.
Bucket bounds and names are inputs: change them on the inputs sheet; the lists must stay in the same order.

items.label: Display scale (fixed at 1000)
items.note: Fixed: every unit label of an amount in this template is in KRW thousand; the open amounts are landed in KRW and divided by this scale. A model in another unit needs the labels changed (README).

checks.label: Aging grid total equals the raw open amount
Invoice count grid total equals the raw row count
Past due % times total equals total less not-due amount (total not 0)
checks.note: A total of 0 gives 0 % (IFERROR in Past due %), so the actual side is 0. The expected side is then 0 less the not-due amount: 0 when no amount is open, not 0 (the check fails) when not-due and past-due amounts cancel out.

checks.label: Over-90 total equals the open amount of invoices in the last bucket

notes.text: The nested-IF ladder IF(d<=0,"Not due",IF(d<=30,...)) is replaced by two helper columns: MATCH on the bucket bounds, then INDEX on the bucket names.
An invoice of a customer missing from the customer list drops out of the grids; the raw-total checks then fail.
